page_title: TOU 0-1 ANG | Toulouse v Angers 23/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Today's referee Marc Bollengier rightly decides to book Emersonn (Toulouse) for his harsh tackle.

90+2' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
90+1' The ball goes out of play and Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90+1' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florent Hanin (Angers) replacing Himad Abdelli.
90+1' It will be a substitution. Marius Courcoul (Angers) is ready to enter the pitch as Amine Sbai walks off.
88' Amine Sbai (Angers) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
86' Emersonn (Toulouse) fails to score from inside the box as his rebound pings off the bar!

86' Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
85' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Harouna Djibirin (Angers), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
83' Toulouse get a corner.
82' Here is a change. Mark McKenzie is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Julian Vignolo (Toulouse).

82' What a great effort! Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Louis Mouton as he is replaced by Harouna Djibirin (Angers).
78' Emersonn (Toulouse) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
77' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Jacques Ekomie (Angers) for a tough tackle.
72' Substitution. Dayann Methalie makes his way off the pitch and Noah Edjouma (Toulouse) comes on as his replacement.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) replaces Alexis Vossah.
68' Alexandre Dujeux prepares a substitution. Sidiki Cherif is replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
66' Substitution. Rafik Messali (Toulouse) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Frank Magri walks off.
64' Amine Sbai (Angers) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
62' Ousmane Camara (Angers) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
60' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
59' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the resulting free kick, but no praise for this shot as it blazes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

58' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Toulouse are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
55' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Aron Donnum (Toulouse), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
54' Frank Magri (Toulouse) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' Amine Sbai (Angers) brings an opponent down and Marc Bollengier interrupts the game.

48' Louis Mouton (Angers) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Marc Bollengier blows for a foul after Ousmane Camara (Angers) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
44' The resulting corner from Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is cleared by the opposition's defence. Toulouse earn a corner.

44' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
44' The ball is out of play. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner.
42' Dangerous play by Frank Magri (Toulouse). Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
40' A pass by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
37' Amine Sbai (Angers) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
35' Amine Sbai (Angers) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
33' Himad Abdelli (Angers) commits a rough foul. Marc Bollengier stops the game and makes a call. Toulouse will take a free kick near the side line.
31' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
31' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Toulouse have a corner.

30' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
29' Haris Belkebla (Angers) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marc Bollengier ignores the protests.
27' Amine Sbai (Angers) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
25' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) is easily saved by Herve Koffi.
21' Herve Koffi (Angers) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
20' The game is interrupted now, Herve Koffi (Angers) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

18' Emersonn (Toulouse) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Herve Koffi displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
16' 0 - 1 Goal! Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Guillaume Restes. He makes it 0:1.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
10' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) unleashes a shot towards the goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
6' Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
4' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
2' Ousmane Camara (Angers) was too forceful with his tackle and Marc Bollengier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Angers will take the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will officiate today.
